```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
tuesdata <- tidytuesdayR::tt_load('2021-01-26')
tuesdata <- tidytuesdayR::tt_load(2021, week = 5)

plastics <- tuesdata$plastics
```

## Summary 1 Unmodified Column with Iteration

```{r}
#total plastic per country for a given year
total_by_country <- function(yr) {
  plastics |>
    filter(year == yr, parent_company == "Grand Total") |>
    select(country, year, grand_total, volunteers) |>
    slice_max(grand_total, n = 10)
}

map(c(2019, 2020), total_by_country) |>
  bind_rows() |>
  gt::gt()
```
